name: Hybrid Transparency
definition: A blending formulation that combines depth-ordered alpha blending for the first K fragments (the 'core') with order-independent accumulation for the remaining fragments (the 'tail') to mitigate popping artifacts while maintaining real-time performance.
summary: Hybrid Transparency mitigates popping artifacts in 3D Gaussian Splatting by combining depth-ordered blending for the foremost fragments with order-independent accumulation for the rest, avoiding the cost of full sorting.
